name: What are common signs that my tile roof needs repair?
description: Look for cracked, broken, or missing tiles, water stains inside your home, or a sagging roofline. Granules in gutters can also be a sign of wear.

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my tile roof needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs indicating your tile roof may need repair include cracked, broken, or missing tiles. You might also notice discolored ceilings or walls indoors, which suggests a leak. Granules collecting in gutters can indicate wear, and a visible sag in the roofline points to underlying structural issues. Inspecting your attic for water stains or dampness after rain can also confirm a leak source. Addressing these issues early can prevent more extensive and costly damage to your home's structure.
